得到一份本人的画像报告（几条主线各是什么、精力怎么分），以及把各条主线的事排进日: A portrait report of you (what each of your tracks is, how your energy is shared) and a plan that puts every track's work on one calendar
得到画像报告与第一周计划: Get a portrait report and the first week's plan

放进正在进行的这一轮，访谈者马上读到: Put it into the round that is running; the interviewer reads it right away

你正在投入的几条主线。访谈中随时可以改。: The tracks you are putting time into. You can change them at any point in the interview.
先放简历，再放计划、作品、日程这类文件。访谈先读材料，只问材料里没有的。: Your résumé first, then files such as plans, work and schedules. The interview reads them first and asks only what they do not say.
可以跳过，之后在设置里连接。: You can skip this and connect one later in Settings.
访谈从你的材料和回答出发：经历和处境、在意什么、精力怎么起落，再到每条主线五年后: The interview starts from your material and your answers: your story and where you are now, what you care about, how your energy rises and falls, then what each track looks like in five years, its milestones and its first tasks. 已经放入的材料在左侧，访谈会先读。: The material you added is on the left; the interview reads it first.

免费账号的额度较少，访谈可能做不完；做两轮后这里会按实际用量估算还够几轮。: A free account has little quota and may not finish the interview; after two rounds this estimates how many rounds are left from actual use.
